According to Axios, Nvidia has received approval to sell its H200 chips to China, with the US government set to receive a 25 per cent share of all sales. The H200 is a significant improvement over the H20, the downgraded model Nvidia was required to develop under earlier export restrictions and which China mostly rejected.
